pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

4. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 25

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 12

7. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

9. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 72

10. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 15

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — x > 5

2. B — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121
Final Answer: 121
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. C — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. A — 24
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 6
3. Product = 24
Final Answer: 24
